text:
Anya: Quick design check on rollout panel — uploaded a compact mock with safer rollback flow: https://figma.com/file/zzz/canary-safety. Can we scan CTA copy + timeline density?
Devon: Saw it. 'Start Canary' vs 'Launch Canary' — prefer 'Launch Canary (x% traffic)'. Clearer.
María: A11y: ensure the percent control has aria-describedby and presets (1,5,10,20,50). Also contrast for timestamps.
Sandeep: Rollback action should live in the row menu and open a guarded modal, not an inline red button.
Oliver: Modal rules: focus trap, primary = Rollback, secondary = Cancel. For >50% require typed-confirm. Add data-test attrs.
Kai: Backend note: we'll accept preset ticks and add fields rollback.manual_delay_seconds + rollback.reason. Automation sets delay=0.
Anya: Timeline: default compact on small screens, with per-row expand. Also a horizontal scrubber for quick preview.
Devon: Scrub previews should be cached and metric fetches debounced. Telemetry events: deploy.rollback_initiated, ui.timeline_scrub.
María: Accessibility sweep after Figma update: will check focus order, roles (alertdialog), reduced-motion.
RolloutBot: Canary launched for "payments-api" at 10% by Anya — /deployments/payments-api/rollouts/98765 :rocket: 
Anya: Thanks — I'll update the frames with CTA copy, typed-confirm rule, and the compact toggle. Expect update in ~90m.
Sandeep: If no objections, we'll hand off to eng after Figma update. :thumbsup:
